_: LOCAL-CUTOUT COMPATIBILITY MANIFEST (local BG §9). The toolchain and SDK versions the on-device engines were last VALIDATED against -- not merely compiled against. ML Kit Subject Segmentation is a beta dependency whose model ships through Google Play services, and Apple Vision's behaviour is tied to the OS, so 'it still builds' is not evidence that either still works. scripts/verify_local_cutout_release.py fingerprints this file together with the native sources; when any value here changes, previously recorded device evidence stops matching and a release must re-run the device matrix. Bump a value only alongside fresh validation -- never to make a build pass.

pinned._: Changing any of these requires the full local-cutout device matrix again. Renovate/Dependabot/`flutter upgrade`/`gradle --refresh-dependencies`/`pod update` must not move them on their own. This is a REVALIDATION requirement, not a permanent freeze: security updates are expected, they just cannot ship as an unvalidated side effect of an unrelated task.
